ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the line $y=-\frac{4}{3}x+8$ intersects the x-axis at point A and the y-axis at point B. A moving point C starts from point B, moving towards point A at a uniform speed of 1 unit per second along direction $BA$. Simultaneously, a moving point D starts from point A, moving towards point O at a uniform speed of 2 units per second along direction $AO$. When one point stops moving, the other point stops as well. Let the time of movement be t seconds ($t>0$). Directly state the value of t when the area of $\triangle ACD$ is $\frac{84}{5}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the line $y=-\frac{4}{3}x+8$ intersects the x-axis at point A and the y-axis at point B. A moving point C starts from point B, moving towards point A at a uniform speed of 1 unit per second along direction $BA$. Simultaneously, a moving point D starts from point A, moving towards point O at a uniform speed of 2 units per second along direction $AO$. When one point stops moving, the other point stops as well. Let the time of movement be $t$ seconds ($t>0$). Directly state the value of $t$ when the area of $\triangle ACD$ is $\frac{84}{5}$.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a rectangular coordinate system, the x-axis is horizontal to the right, the y-axis is vertical upward, and O is marked near the origin; an oblique line extends from the intercept on the positive y-axis down to the right to the intercept on the positive x-axis, matching the situation in the problem where the straight line intersects the two coordinate axes to form line segment BA. Then reason: From the straight line y=-(4/3)x+8, the y-axis intercept is B=(0,8), and the x-axis intercept is A=(6,0), so AB=sqrt(6^2+8^2)=10. C moves from B along the direction BA at 1 unit/second, and the unit direction vector of BA is (6,-8)/10=(3/5,-4/5), so after t seconds C=(3t/5, 8-4t/5). D moves from A along the direction AO at 2 units/second, and AO is on the x-axis, so D=(6-2t,0), and AD=2t. Taking AD as the base, the height from C to the x-axis is 8-4t/5, so the area of triangle ACD is (1/2)*2t*(8-4t/5)=8t-(4/5)t^2. Let the area be equal to 84/5, obtaining 8t-(4/5)t^2=84/5; multiplying by 5 gives 40t-4t^2=84, that is t^2-10t+21=0, solving gives t=3 or t=7. Since the time needed for D to reach O is 6/2=3 seconds, and when one point stops the other also stops, the allowable range is 0<t<=3, so keep t=3.
